bias.label: Leaning down below 3,750; dipped under 3,700 in Asia, then bounced

event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed index Thu 19 Nov 15:30 SAST, then Fed Hammack 15:50 SAST (Finviz calendar).

bullets.title: New low in Asia
bullets.text: Gold broke under 3,700 early on Thursday, with a print of 3,697.45 and a low near 3,693.5 (exact low and time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Bounce back to 3,724
bullets.text: FXEmpire showed spot near 3,723.84 at 06:45 SAST, so buyers stepped in under the round number.

bullets.title: Hawkish Fed minutes
bullets.text: Wednesday's minutes showed some officials wanted a hike, and gold fell about 3.3% on the day.

bullets.title: Hike odds near 95%
bullets.text: Mitrade says odds of a quarter-point hike on 8-9 December rose to about 95%, with some talk of a half-point move.

bullets.title: Strong dollar, high yields
bullets.text: The dollar index hit about 103.8, its highest since April 2025, and the 10-year yield was near 5.07% (Mitrade; not checked live, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Busy US afternoon
bullets.text: Jobless claims and the Philly Fed index land at 15:30 SAST, with Fed speakers after, so expect fast moves.

bullets.title: Stretched but trending
bullets.text: Gold is down about 7.8% in a week, so sharp bounces can happen inside the downtrend.

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price reaching 3,630-3,650 and holding there, not slicing through.

watch: Buying the bounce at 3,724 in the middle of nowhere. Wait for the zone and a hold.
